title: Ukuhlebeza Emoyeni
intro: Cabanga ngombuso lapho okungabonakali nokubonwayo kuhlangene khona, bese umi phambi komuntu osenhliziyweni yombuso ongafani nanoma yimuphi omunye. Lomphefumulo unolwazi olungaphezu kokufinyelela okuvamile, amandla alawulayo abanye abangawacabanga kuphela. Kodwa-ke, ngisho namandla amakhulu angathotshiswa yisidalwa esincane, futhi iqiniso lingahlala lifihliwe kuze kube yisikhathi esimisiwe. Ubani lo muntu onefa elihlala lizwakala phakathi neminyaka?
clues: Nganikwa umbuso okungekho muntu emva kwami ​​owayeyoba nawo.
Umoya wawungaphansi komyalo wami, uhamba nge-oda lami noma kuphi lapho ngifisa khona.
Ngangikwazi ukuqonda inkulumo yezinyoni, futhi zazikhonza ebuthweni lami.
Ngithole izindaba ezivela enyonini encane mayelana nendlovukazi eyayikhulekela ilanga.
Ukufa kwami ​​kwahlala kufihliwe kwaze kwaba yilapho isidalwa somhlaba sidla induku yami, futhi yilapho kuphela lapho ama-jinn aqaphela khona ukuthi awazazi izinto ezingabonakali.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Ukufa kwakhe kwafihlwa kuma-jinn kwaze kwaba yilapho induku yakhe idliwa
outcome.answer: Ukufa kwakhe kwafihlwa kuma-jinn kwaze kwaba yilapho induku yakhe idliwa

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
